channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jeff Green | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jeff Green from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Jeff Green, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
Gordon said confidently to Nuggets.com.

“I hate losing [Kentavious Caldwell-Pope] and Jeff Green, but I like our additions.”

Aaron Gordon on Jeff Green, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Oct 12, 2024. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Jeff Green, Tim Duncan, Ishmael Smith, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
DeAndre Jordan told B/R after Game 3.

“When Nikola says something, everybody's awareness is heightened. I always compare him to a guy like Tim Duncan. He's never really super boisterous, but when he does speak, it speaks volumes. Me, Jeff Green, DJ, Ish [Smith], KCP, we'll always give our two cents on things we see during the game, but Nikola saying something elevated the message. I've been on him more about being more vocal, and even in tonight's game, he was extremely vocal and it was good for our team.”

DeAndre Jordan on Jeff Green, Tim Duncan, Ishmael Smith, Nikola Jokic, Jun 8, 2023. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey
item.description:
“Josh Giddey is great. Sam Presti, I don’t understand this guy’s eye for talent. He drafted KD, Russ [Westbrook], Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey and the list goes on and on and on. This guy is pretty damn good.”

LeBron James on Sam Presti, Jeff Green, Serge Ibaka, Reggie Jackson, Josh Giddey, Feb 20, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jeff Green
item.description:
Ryan Blackburn:Michael Malone on Jeff Green, mentions Denver’s optional days when Denver doesn’t have a game:

“Jeff learned from a young age that ‘optional’ means ‘mandatory’...The example that he sets for our guys with his work ethic is tremendous.”

Michael Malone on Jeff Green, Jan 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Steve Nash on Jeff Green
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Nash on Jeff Green, even if he is cleared:

“I don’t think we’d expect him to play a ton of minutes.”

Steve Nash on Jeff Green, Jun 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Jeff Green
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the Nets going small with Jeff Green at the 5:

“I think Jeff as a 5 has really been effective. I should have played him at the 5 more. But obviously we have Rudy there and minutes were hard to come by. ... He’s a weapon at that position.”

Quin Snyder on Jeff Green, Jan 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Jeff Green
item.description:
Blake Griffin on texting Jeff Green:

“I texted him and literally like I think like 30 minutes later it was like 'Jeff Green has signed with the Utah Jazz'.”

Blake Griffin on Jeff Green, Jul 27, 2019. Source: podcastone.com.

item.title: Ed Davis on Jeff Green
item.description:
Eric Walden:Ed Davis on why he joined the Jazz:

“At this stage of my career, I wanted to play on ... a team that has a chance to contend for a title at the end of the year. Jeff Green: “With the personnel that they were building ... the opportunity to win was most important.”

Ed Davis on Jeff Green, Jul 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Jeff Green
item.description:
“We’re still behind a lot of games in the playoff chase, but the confidence level our guys have, hopefully that continues to remain at a high level. But Brad is really leading that charge, along with some good, solid veteran play. Jeff Green has been solid, at both ends, and in the locker room. Trevor (Ariza) has come in and made a statement of who he is as a player, and he’s done a good job of helping us, leading our team as well.”

Scott Brooks on Jeff Green, Jan 22, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jeff Green
item.description:
Doc Rivers:

“I was very ready to go into the playoffs with Lance. I just thought if we could upgrade -- like a Jeff Green -- I would.”

Doc Rivers on Jeff Green, Feb 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Jeff Green
item.description:
Joerger said, cryptically, on Thursday:

“Jeff Green is the least of our problems. Most people on the inside know what it is. And it's not Jeff Green.”

Dave Joerger on Jeff Green, Mar 16, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Jeff Green
item.description:
Joerger isn’t planning to make any changes despite criticism and statistical analysis that point toward there being a problem with Green starting.

“Jeff Green is the least of our problems. Most people on the inside know what it is,”

Dave Joerger on Jeff Green, Mar 12, 2015. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jeff Green
item.description:
Peter Stringer:Brad Stevens on Jeff Green:

“He's a big part of what we do. He's a big part of who we are. He's a guy that we go to.”

Brad Stevens on Jeff Green, Dec 5, 2013. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Jeff Green, Courtney Lee, Kelly Olynyk
item.description:
“I’ve had a chance to watch them a couple times on TV. Obviously you see their big rookie [Kelly Olynyk]; you see [Jared] Sullinger, he’s taken the next step [and] I think he’s finally healthy; and then when they get Rondo back, this team has a bright future. Jeff Green, I expect him to emerge and really have a good season; Courtney Lee is comfortable out there; Avery [Bradley], it’s time for him to really step up. So they have some nice pieces to build with.”

Paul Pierce on Jeff Green, Courtney Lee, Kelly Olynyk, Oct 16, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Rajon Rondo, Brandon Bass, Jeff Green
item.description:
Kevin Garnett:

“I think Boston's going to be fine. That team has always been proven, they always succeed, always push the envelope when it comes to winning, and they have good pieces up there-- Jeff Green, Rajon (Rondo), Brandon Bass, guys up there that's really hard-working guys, that will come in and compete every night, are going to put forth a valid effort. So they're not going to be shabby, not at all.”

Kevin Garnett on Rajon Rondo, Brandon Bass, Jeff Green, Sep 10, 2013. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Chris Wilcox on Jeff Green
item.description:
Considering that both are healthy enough, following their respective heart surgeries last winter, to start practicing today with the Celtics, this support network is already off to a strong start.

“I’ll definitely feel a bond with Jeff Green for the rest of my life,”

Chris Wilcox on Jeff Green, Sep 28, 2012. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jeff Green, Jason Terry
item.description:
“I don’t want to mention names, but we have been in contact with them. We’ll continue to find the best player we can. “We’ve added a couple of great professionals in Jeff Green and Jason Terry, and we drafted three guys that I think are very professional and add to the locker room. Talent is a hard thing to find but we put a great deal of value into what goes on in the locker room also.”

Danny Ainge on Jeff Green, Jason Terry, Jul 8, 2012. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: David Falk on Jeff Green
item.description:
Ken Berger:Falk on Green agreement with Boston:

“I'm very happy. I can't say I'm surprised. He's where he wants to be.”

David Falk on Jeff Green, Jul 7, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jeff Green
item.description:
Gary Dzen:Ainge:

“I feel good about Jeff (Green) and where he's at. He wants to come back and we want him back.”

Danny Ainge on Jeff Green, Jul 2, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on Jeff Green, Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Wyc Grousbeck on the Kendrick Perkins trade:

“I love Perk, but I don't think our issue was guarding the 5-spot. Our issue was guarding their 2, 3, 4. So not only did we need Jeff Green, we needed about 3 more of him.”

Wyc Grousbeck on Jeff Green, Kendrick Perkins, May 26, 2011. Source: CSNNE.com.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Jeff Green
item.description:
Don't tell Danny Ainge the Celtics are out of the NBA playoffs because they traded Kendrick Perkins.

“I don't think that the presence of one player standing in the middle of the paint was going to [help] our offense score more, wasn't going to prevent LeBron James from shooting step-back 3-point jump shots with Paul Pierce and Jeff Green draped all over him,”

Danny Ainge on Jeff Green, May 16, 2011. Source: CSNNE.com.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Jeff Green
item.description:
Rivers continued on Perkins:

“Well, I would wait until after the year is over. I’ll put it that way. I do think Jeff Green has a chance to be a starter for us in the future and a hell of a basketball player. And Krstic can help. But making that trade at the time we made that trade, that made it very tough for us. And not only that, we added other pieces as well that we tried to fit in.”

Kendrick Perkins on Jeff Green, May 16, 2011. Source: Boston Globe.
